text: Foris DAX MT Ltd. (Malta) is owned by Foris Holdings KY Limited, a Cayman Islands corporation that is the top-tier holding company of the Crypto.com group.

source.name: U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, Corporate Decision #1367 (Crypto.com National Trust Bank)
source.quote: Cayman Islands corporation, owns Foris DAX MT Ltd. and is the top-tier holding company for the Crypto.com family of companies.
